specification.rationale: The project specification owns observable product behavior.

acceptanceCriteria.outcome: Existing supported consumers continue to work or receive reviewed migration guidance
The authorized user can complete the requested behavior and invalid input is rejected
The implementation has bounded ownership and automated regression coverage
Operators can correlate bounded, redacted evidence with the change and verification cycle
Setup, failure, recovery, rollback, and generated-state cleanup are documented and verified
Resource consumption remains within declared time, memory, output, and input bounds
Failure, timeout, interruption, and retry behavior is deterministic and fail-closed
Trust boundaries, unsafe inputs, credentials, and dependencies are explicitly verified
Released source, metadata, evidence, and artifacts share one verified identity

assessments.rationale: The change affects a supported product surface.
Observable behavior must satisfy its product contract.
The new behavior needs durable ownership and regression coverage.
Operational evidence must be attributable without retaining raw secrets.
Operators need deterministic setup, recovery, rollback, and cleanup.
All untrusted work and evidence must have resource bounds.
The example behavior stores and transmits no personal data.
Failure modes must be deterministic and recoverable.
Authorization and trust boundaries are part of the behavior.
Published outputs must bind to reviewed source and evidence.

trustBoundaries.statement: The project owns authorization and observable behavior for the bounded product operation.

faultRows.trigger: An authorized or unauthorized caller invokes the product operation with valid or invalid input.
faultRows.injectionBoundary: The public operation entry point before any state mutation.
faultRows.expectedOutcome: Authorized valid input completes once; unauthorized or invalid input fails without mutation.

proof.assertion: Focused contract tests and supported-platform evidence prove both accepted and rejected calls.

faultRows.stopCondition: The row is complete when both valid completion and fail-closed rejection pass on the exact reviewed checkpoint.
